title: Upstream handoff record
description: The read-only JSON file referenced by AGENTBOX_UPSTREAM_<KEY>, one per declared upstream, describing that upstream's latest materialization for the downstream's matching partition (FR-011/FR-012/FR-012a). Always present, even when there is no matching-partition materialization.

partition.description: The matching partition (identity daily->daily), or null for an unpartitioned upstream.

materialized.description: true when a matching-partition materialization exists; false marks "no materialization" (FR-012a).

output_files.description: The upstream's output file paths for the matching partition; [] when not materialized.

report.description: The spec-007 run report metadata union recorded on the materialization (status, tokens_in, tokens_out, turns, cost_usd, files_written, notes, ...); null when not materialized.

materialized_at.description: ISO-8601 materialization time of the latest matching materialization; null when not materialized.

chain_depth.description: The producing run's chain_depth, used by the downstream to derive its own (R7); null when not materialized.

automated.description: Whether the producing run was automated; a manual upstream contributes 0 to a downstream's chain_depth (R7/FR-015); null when not materialized.
